summary: Confirmed: one map/GIS 'Designated Camping Area' (GIS 541 = pin) in a clearing at the west edge of the ramp lot, with a privy. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin kept; not waterfront kept; phone differs (page 573-226-3616, stored 417-256-7161).
flags: INCLUSION OK (designated point at a lot edge, the Lick Creek case): area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Designated Camping Sites | Individual Campsites'; the map (Last Updated 9/14/2026) has a 'Camping Area' symbol beside the Privy and ADA Parking symbols, the Concrete Boat Ramp just north; GIS 27 point 541 is typed 'Designated Camping Area'. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101. No brochure is posted.

PIN: stored 36.51195,-91.17105 = GIS 541, in a bare-earth clearing under open trees ~15-25 m west of the paved lot (lot 638, 36 m), where a parked vehicle or small camper shows in the imagery. Keep. The clearing is small (roughly 25 x 25 m); a 23-ft rig would back in off the lot's west edge - pad size is not published.

ACCESS (the 2 miles past the pavement): MDC's directions are 'Route H south 4 miles to the end of the pavement, then County Road H-278 another 2 miles'; the map labels it CR 278 (a 'Non MDC Road'). On a 3.4 km imagery frame the road is a straight graded gravel county road across upland fields and woods with farmsteads along it, with no stream crossing in the last 3 km and the Eleven Point not crossed; it ends at a paved lot with ADA parking and a concrete boat ramp (boat trailers use it). Nothing on the page or map says 4WD, high clearance or low-water crossing. Read as 2WD passable; Overpass was down (timed out twice), so no OSM surface/ford tags were read and this rests on imagery and the MDC pages.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The camping clearing is ~55-60 m from the Eleven Point River (~45 m of open water here) with the paved ramp lot (day use) and a line of bank trees between; no open apron. A winter glimpse of the river across the lot is possible but was not established - a riverview lead at most.
HORSES: none. CLUSTERS: one camping area.
PHONE: the page lists '(573) 226-3616'; stored 417-256-7161 does not match.
FACILITIES: privy on the map beside the camping area (not written).
